title: Synology patches critical DSM OAuth flaw (CVSS 9.8) and NGINX HTTP/2 flaw (CVSS 8.1)
what_changed: SA_26_20 revised 26 Nov now lists BeeStation OS 1.5.6-68000 as the NGINX fix; only the OAuth flaw (SA_26_21) and DSM Enterprise 1.0 (NGINX) remain Ongoing. Summary, plain, action and impact updated.
